meaning.en: Any of a series of saturated hydrocarbons with open chains, having the formula CnH2n+2: these compounds are sometimes said to be in the methane or paraffin series.

meaning.en: Any member of the alkane series.

meaning.en: (organic chemistry) Any of saturated hydrocarbons including methane, ethane and compounds with long carbon chain known as paraffins etc., having a chemical formula of the form CnH2n+2.
meaning.vi: (hóa học hữu cơ) Bất kỳ hiđrocacbon no nào bao gồm metan, etan và các hợp chất có mạch cacbon dài được gọi là parafin, v.v., có công thức hóa học ở dạng CnH2n + 2.
